messages:
incident-bot: [ALERT] KV cache eviction spike + continuous-batching amplification detected for prod-cluster-3. Error budget crossing threshold. Auto-pager triggered.
Alice Tran: seeing 5xx uptick and tail latency climb on embeddings route. dashboards show per-tenant QPS jump.
Miguel Santos: confirmed. KV cache miss rate up 18% vs baseline, eviction rate spiked. Likely batching config misbehaving on long-prefix requests.
Priya Iyer: rolling logs now --- getting lots of `cache_shard_evicted` + `batch_queue_size` warnings.
Lina Park: impact: 10% of requests in APAC hitting >1s extra latency, some customer timeouts. Which customers flagged?
Miguel Santos: tenant-slice: corp-42 and corp-77 highest. corp-42 has heavy multi-turn chat workloads.
Alice Tran: can we flip per-customer override for corp-42 to disable continuous batching?
Priya Iyer: yes we have a per-customer override flag: `batching.continuous.enabled:tenant:<tenant_id>`.
Dan O'Neill: I can do the override but want to canary first. Suggest canary on corp-77 (smaller) then corp-42 if stable.
Alice Tran: agreed. corp-77 is lower traffic. Do we have a quick rollback plan?
Miguel Santos: rollback is removing the tenant-specific flag (instant). Also global fallback: reduce `batch_window_ms` from 25 -> 5 which reduces amplification but increases tokens cost.
Priya Iyer: I'll prepare commands.
Priya Iyer: /deploy-bot run: `flag set batching.continuous.enabled tenant=corp-77 false --author=priya`
deploy-bot: Scheduling flag change: `batching.continuous.enabled` -> tenant corp-77 -> false. Change ID: FLG-9832. Applying to edge control-plane.
deploy-bot: Flag applied to corp-77 in prod-cluster-3.
Lina Park: observing metrics for corp-77 now. Miss rate dropping slightly.
Alice Tran: corp-77 latency down ~40% in last 30s. Good signal.
Dan O'Neill: proceed to corp-42?
Priya Iyer: proceeding: `/deploy-bot run: flag set batching.continuous.enabled tenant=corp-42 false --author=priya --canary=false`
deploy-bot: Applying flag for corp-42. Change ID: FLG-9833.
deploy-bot: Flag applied to corp-42 in prod-cluster-3.
Miguel Santos: corp-42 tail latency improving. KV eviction rate dropping back toward baseline.
Alice Tran: customers on corp-42 still have some retries in the window. Support, can we send a quick note?
support-bot: Drafting customer advisory for corp-42 and corp-77: "We detected elevated latency due to internal batching and cache behavior. We applied a temporary per-tenant override to stabilize latency. Engineering is monitoring and we'll follow up."
Lina Park: also turned on increased logging for corp-42 (sampling 100%).
Priya Iyer: rolling a conservative global config to avoid recurrence: `/deploy-bot run: config patch batching.batch_window_ms=10 --author=priya --scope=prod-cluster-3`
deploy-bot: Patch queued; will apply in 30s to avoid simultaneous churn.
Alice Tran: metrics steady. No new 5xxs in last 2m.
Miguel Santos: heads up: this tenant override increases per-token cost for those tenants. Notify billing?
Dan O'Neill: noted. support-bot, include note about degraded unit economics in customer advisory.
support-bot: updated advisory with billing note.
Priya Iyer: monitoring for next 15m then we'll either keep overrides or re-introduce continuous batching with adjusted parameters.
Alice Tran: quick postmortem items: root cause hypothesis = workload skew + batch_window default allowing excessive inter-tenant KV cache pressure. Action items: 1) tighten default batch window on prod, 2) add auto-disable rule for per-tenant burst detection, 3) add a dashboard for tenant-level batch amplification.
Miguel Santos: I'll own #2 and #3. Dan, can you coordinate billing estimate with finance?
Dan O'Neill: yep.
Lina Park: logging retention for corp-42 sampling will be rolled down after 1h.
Alice Tran: great work. If we see reversion, escalate to SRE channel and we'll re-open page. Closing this thread in 1h if stable. :white_check_mark:
